question: Which of the following personalities is a well-known Indian plant physiologist and physicist?
solution:
The correct answer is __**JC Bose.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jagadish Chandra Bose** was a multi-talented personality who made significant contributions to the fields of **physics, biology, and archaeology.**
 
• He is credited with inventing the first wireless communication device, known as the** "coherer"**, and for demonstrating the response of plants to various stimuli, such as **light, sound, and electricity.**
 
• Bose's research on plant physiology laid the foundation for modern **biophysics **and helped advance the understanding of how plants respond to their environment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **CV Raman** was a physicist who discovered the **Raman Effect.**

 
 
• It won him a** Nobel Prize in Physics** in** 1930. **
 
 
 
• **CNR Rao** is a** chemist **who has made significant contributions to the field of solid-state chemistry.
 
 
• One of the first people to **synthesize two-dimensional oxide materials,** like La₂CuO₄, was Rao.
 
 
 
• **JRD Tata** was a pioneering** Indian industrialist and philanthropist.**
 
 
• He was given the** French Legion of Honour in 1983,** and the** Padma Vibhushan and Bharat Ratna**, two of India's highest civilian honors, were given to him in 1955 and 1992.
